entities.name: Silvar
entities.description: Giant Cat Nightmare of Ikoria who lives in the chasms of the Savai triome; bonded to Trynn.

entities.name: Trynn
entities.description: Former Coppercoat and secret bonder of Silvar who stayed in Drannith and feeds corrupt officials to Silvar.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: City on Ikoria where Trynn lives and whose government is corrupt.

entities.name: Savai
entities.description: Triome of Ikoria whose chasms Silvar inhabits.

entities.name: Coppercoats
entities.description: Drannith's city guard, of which Trynn was a member.

events.summary: Trynn stays in Drannith after her eludha, keeping her identity as a bonder secret.
events.quote: She keeps her identity as a bonder secret

events.summary: Trynn lures corrupt officials outside Drannith and feeds them to Silvar.
events.quote: she lures them outside the city and feeds them to her partner, Silvar.
